subTitle: Answers to the questions we hear most about Hyper 0X and our products.

faqs.question: What is Hyper 0X?
faqs.answer: Hyper 0X is Buckleson's own permissioned L1 blockchain, engineered from scratch. It uses leaderless aBFT consensus for deterministic finality, hybrid post-quantum encryption on every connection, and gives every customer their own L2. All Buckleson products run on it.

faqs.question: Can you build a custom blockchain for my company?
faqs.answer: Yes. That is our core service. We design a dedicated L2 on Hyper 0X with your own policies, privacy model and bridges, integrate it with your existing systems, and support you from pilot to production.

faqs.question: What does asset tokenization involve?
faqs.answer: We help you represent real-world assets such as gold, funds, bonds or invoices on-chain, with compliance rules like limits, KYC and approvals enforced as code before any transaction executes. Trades settle atomically: both legs or neither.

faqs.question: How does Pavii protect AI agents?
faqs.answer: Pavii connects to Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode or your own agents. Every agent call passes six security gates that stop prompt injection, data leaks, excessive agency, runaway costs, rogue agents, supply-chain attacks, unsafe output and log tampering, and every action is recorded on Hyper 0X.

faqs.question: Is Hyper 0X quantum-safe?
faqs.answer: Hyper 0X is post-quantum-resistant under known attacks. Every connection uses hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519 key exchange, so an attacker would have to break both the lattice and the elliptic-curve scheme.

faqs.question: Can I connect Hyper 0X to other blockchains?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bridge adapters connect Hyper 0X to EVM chains, Solana and Sui, and our SDKs reach bank DLTs and APIs. Any L2 can also run its own bridge.

faqs.question: When do H0X Pay and HyperRun launch?
faqs.answer: Both are coming soon. Contact us to join the early-access list and we'll let you know as soon as they launch.
